errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the figure illustrates changes in average values of bed-days and their structural effect for selected time periods, while the figure shows continuous data for all years between 2008 and 2021.

The machine-generated description does not explicitly state that Figure A illustrates changes in average bed-days over the years and Figure B illustrates the structural effect on average bed-days as a percentage change.
The description does not mention the Y-axis label for Figure A ('Средни леглодни (дни)') or its range (200 to 280 days).
The description does not mention the Y-axis label for Figure B ('Структурен ефект върху средни леглодни (%)') or its range (0% to over 2%).
The description does not mention the X-axis range (2008 to 2021) or the specific intervals marked (2008, 2012, 2013, 2017, 2021).
The description does not mention the red lines and black markers used in both graphs to represent the data points.
The description does not mention the trends in Figure A, such as the initial decrease, slight increase in 2013, and significant drop to 200 days in 2021.
The description does not mention the trends in Figure B, such as the sharp drop to 0.3% in 2013 and the subsequent rise to nearly 2.8% in 2021.
